step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified core visual entities: End User actor, Account A VPC containing NAT Gateways and EKS clusters across public/private subnets, Account B VPC containing AWS WAF, ALB, and EKS cluster, and On-Premises Data Center.
2. Normalised non-standard service naming according to valid vocabulary (mapped User actor to UserConsumerWeb, kept standard AWS services NAT, EKS, WAF, ALB, and OnPremDC).
3. Fused multi-AZ redundant visual subnets (NAT Gateways and EKS nodes in Account A) into logical unit nodes to clarify functional routing paths.
4. Mapped incoming web request flow in Account B: User -> WAF -> ALB -> EKS (Account B).
5. Mapped outbound and hybrid connectivity for Account A based on transcript: EKS (Account A) -> NAT Gateway for outbound connectivity, and EKS (Account A) -> On-Premises DC via Direct Connect.
